label: original-phase steps 3-6 after a specific prefix (first token w/k/q, m/j in positions 2-3)
explanation: Sparse feature (0.02% of steps). Fires almost only in the original phase at t=3-6 (about 97% of mass at t=3-5), never at t<3, and essentially never in the copy phase. It seems to need a particular combination of history: first token w/k/q (w alone is 9x lift), m two steps back (11x) or j one step back (13x), current input w/q/b/m/n/i, and mostly letters (few digits). Top example: w k k j [m]. No simple predicate captures it. The best conjunction gets dev F1 0.15 (precision 0.10, recall 0.30), so it looks like a distributed hash of the prefix rather than one nameable property. Magnitude is narrow (median 0.12, max 0.22), and I found no clear driver of magnitude.
